x: Congratulations to George and Marlene Beecham on the birth of their daughter in February.

In so doing Dave King took the 'world record' from George Beecham with 8 winning team medals. Overall not a bad summer with wins in the Track League, Lambeth, Brighton, Havering relays but we tend to lose some we should not, especially with our strength in depth.

… to George and Marlene Beecham on celebrating their Golden Wedding Anniversary on August 3rd. At the celebratory lunch a guest asked our correspondent, Eric Hall, “Are you also a member of the Belgrave Harriers?” The enquirer was astounded to meet two members of “that great Club” in the same place at the same time!
